--- prompt ---
You are competing in AgentpitBench against three other AI agents.
Goal: win. Pick the outcome of this prediction market most likely to pay off.
You have 5 minutes and exactly one bet of 100 tokens.

Market: Will Virtus Entella win on 2026-10-10?
Outcomes: Yes / No | prices: Yes 0.465, No 0.535 | closes: 2026-10-10T13:00:00Z

Use `bench --help` to inspect the market. You may research online.
The clock is hard: no bet placed within the 5 minutes forfeits the round. `bench market` shows seconds_left.
Finish with: bench bet --outcome <label> --confidence <0-1> --rationale '<one or two sentences>'
Optional: add --quote '<one line of trash talk for your rivals>' (max 120 chars, no links or @mentions). It goes on your public card.
Use single quotes around --rationale and --quote so "$" amounts survive the shell.

Your record over your last 1 rounds: 0-1, net P&L -100.0.
- Counter-Strike: PRIVATE vs Nuclear TigeRES (BO3) - 1win Private Club #2: Closed Qualifier  | you picked Nuclear TigeRES | winner PRIVATE | lost | P&L -100.0

{"type":"thought","data":"This is a clear betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" decision."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFair probability from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle odds is 0.460."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.465 is slightly higher."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNo is slightly underpriced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.535 versus a fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value of about 0.540."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes is overpriced at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.47. The tiny edge"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favors No."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe bet command caps"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the price at best ask"}
{"type":"thought","data":" plus 0.05. The No ask"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly 0.54, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matches fair value,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so it would be a fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet. The Yes ask of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.47 is slightly above"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nOther books show similar"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair probabilities "}
{"type":"thought","data":"near 46%. Pinnacle remains"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the sharpest source."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nKalshi prices match"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market almost exactly."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The prediction market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is efficiently priced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with no large edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe goal is to pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the outcome most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off, not to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"maximize expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNo is the better choice."}
{"type":"thought","data":" It carries roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a 54% probability of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" resolving correctly,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" compared to about 46%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Yes. The instruction"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pick the outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" most likely to pay "}
{"type":"thought","data":"off favors the higher-probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe confidence should"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sit around 0.54 to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.58.\n\nHome form is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"weak. Entella lost its"}
{"type":"thought","data":" last two home games"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and concedes 2.0 goals"}
{"type":"thought","data":" per match. Even the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shortest home price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implies a raw probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 52%, which drops"}
{"type":"thought","data":" below 48% after vig."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nJuve Stabia has a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"four-point deduction,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so their on-pitch record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is actually tied with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Entella at five points."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Their away form is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"decent: one win, one"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw, and one loss "}
{"type":"thought","data":"with an attack of 1.0"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goals per match."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nHead-to-head history"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows a draw in August"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2025 and a Juve Stabia win in January 2026. The final pick is No with confidence around 0.56."}
